title: The first-time tour catches up: stories, mysteries and 1871
items: The tour's Interact step says what to do with someone: greet them, hear a story, or ask a question.
The Jaunts step names stories read aloud, mysteries to solve and parts to play. The Settings step names Language, Reading age and Graphics.
A new step, Jump years, rings the year at the top: 1812, 1835, 1871 and its Great Fire, 1904. The tour is eleven steps.
